description: This file defines the SpeedPickerListAdapter class, a custom adapter for a WearableListView that displays a list of speed options in an Android wearable application. It manages view creation, data binding, and the display of speed choices using a dataset of integers.

classes.name: SpeedPickerListAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter class extending WearableListView.Adapter, used to handle a list of speed options displayed on a wearable device.

classes.name: ItemViewHolder
classes.description: An inner static class extending WearableListView.ViewHolder, responsible for holding references to the views within each list item layout.

methods.name: SpeedPickerListAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with context and dataset of speed values.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and inflates a new view holder for list items.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to a view holder at a specific position, setting the display text and tag.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of speed options available in the dataset.
